Author: renasagi
Name: CritLuck
Punchline: Party Critical Hit, Direct Hit, Critical Direct Hit, and overall percentiles.
Description: Shows party hit counts, actual and expected rates, and individual and overall 1–100 percentiles. Use /critluck to open the window.

Author: renasagi
Name: Party Initials
Punchline: Change party-list and chat name formats with /pli.
Description: Changes the party-list and chat name formats together. Use /pli for initials, /pli full for full names, or /pli help for every option.
Changelog: Adds party-list and chat name formatting commands.
